$comment: pulley/registry/blocks/files/manifest.json — created 2026-08-13 (T-14): the files core block. Uploads, stored objects, and attachments other blocks hang off their own entities. Built directly on the T-10b manifest surfaces rather than on paste-in recipes: `endpoints` mounts the three HTTP routes, `routes[].load` feeds the attachments page its server data, and `providesAdapters` ships the S3 StoragePort adapter the app selects with PULLEY_PORT_STORAGE=s3. DEPENDS ON auth (files_file.owner_id is a foreign key into auth_user) but NOT on org — organization_id is a soft scope column with no FK, so the block installs cleanly in a single-tenant app. DATABASE_URL is declared with flags identical to auth's, which the resolver treats as a shared variable (a warning) rather than a conflict. Shared package ranges are byte-identical to auth's because the installer refuses incompatible 0.x caret keys. THE SECURITY INVARIANT, stated here because the manifest is what a reviewer reads first: every serve and presign path forces Content-Disposition: attachment for every MIME type outside server/mime.ts's five-entry inline allow-list — serving user-uploaded HTML or SVG inline from the storage origin is stored XSS.
name: files
description: Uploads, stored files on a swappable storage port, and attachments other blocks hang off their own entities.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Postgres connection string the files tables live in. Same database as the auth block — files_file holds a foreign key into auth_user.

env.name: FILES_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES
env.description: Largest accepted upload, in bytes. Defaults to 26214400 (25 MiB). The whole body is buffered in memory while it is written to storage, so raise this deliberately.

env.name: FILES_SERVE_MODE
env.description: How downloads are delivered: "stream" (default — the app writes the response and owns every header, works with every adapter) or "redirect" (302 to a presigned URL; only for adapters that sign real http(s) URLs, never local-disk).

env.name: FILES_PRESIGN_TTL_SECONDS
env.description: Lifetime of a presigned download URL in redirect mode. Defaults to 300. Must be a positive integer of at most 604800 — S3 will not sign longer.

env.name: FILES_S3_BUCKET
env.description: Bucket the s3 adapter stores objects in. Required only when PULLEY_PORT_STORAGE=s3; the adapter refuses to start without it.

env.name: FILES_S3_REGION
env.description: Region for the s3 adapter (e.g. us-east-1; "auto" for Cloudflare R2). Required only when PULLEY_PORT_STORAGE=s3.

env.name: FILES_S3_ENDPOINT
env.description: Custom S3-compatible endpoint for R2, MinIO or Ceph. Unset = real AWS S3.

env.name: FILES_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE
env.description: Set to "true" for gateways that need path-style addressing (MinIO). AWS and R2 do not.

env.name: FILES_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.description: Static access key for the s3 adapter. Leave BOTH key variables unset to use the AWS default provider chain (instance role, IRSA); setting exactly one is refused as a typo.
